title: Hydrogen spectroscopy from the Fold transition hierarchy
description:
Exact hydrogen spectroscopy from Smithian Fold Theory: the complete principal-count ladder, Lyman-alpha and Balmer-alpha gaps, terminal Lamb, fine and 21-cm hyperfine carriers, reduced-mass ionization scale, electric multipole rates and Zeeman–Stark splitting.

Maria Smith develops the full mathematics and finite closure arguments alongside native Lean verification. The full Lamb and fine frequency intervals lie inside their registered direct experimental targets; the hyperfine central-carrier interval lies inside the 21-cm target and the full propagated interval overlaps it. The hydrogen scale passes the registered ionization and line comparisons. Includes all scale inputs, source-defined comparison conditions, exhaustive grammar proofs, V3/V4 references and reproducible source evidence.

Eleven original entries, 8,960 complete candidate decisions and 1,863 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations. Search topics: hydrogen spectroscopy, Lamb shift, fine structure, hyperfine splitting, Rydberg constant, Lyman alpha, Balmer alpha, multipole transitions, Zeeman effect, Stark effect, Lean theorem prover.

Read the complete paper PDF. Full source evidence and exact-arithmetic reproduction are included.
